Name: BigBubbleMoveLimitter
Notes: An object that limits the movement of a player within a BigBubble assigned to it via a BigBubbleGenerator. Creates a differently shaped and sized "plane of restriction" that BigBubble's movement is restricted to, depending on object name.

Obj_arg0.Name: Move Limitter ID
Obj_arg0.Description: ID of the BigBubbleMoveLimitter associated with generated bubbles. Nonexistent generators crash the game.

Obj_arg1.Name: Attachment Location
Obj_arg1.Description:
Aligns the BigBubble with one of three potential positons relative to the plane of restriction.

If Obj_arg1 = -1: Attaches the BigBubble to the exact middle of the plane of restriction.
If Obj_arg1 = 0: Attaches the BigBubble to the outward facing side of the plane of restriction.
If Obj_arg1 = 1: Attaches the BigBubble to the inward facing side of the plane of restriction.
